title.en: The Flying Fortress 400 km Above You (Real ISS Footage)
title.hi: आपके 400 किमी ऊपर उड़ता किला (ISS का असली फुटेज)
title.es: La fortaleza volante a 400 km sobre ti (Imágenes reales)
title.pt: A fortaleza voadora a 400 km acima de você (Imagens reais)

vo.en: Before your day ends, forty-three separate space modules will complete fifteen laps around Earth. But why?
vo.hi: आपका दिन खत्म होने से पहले, तैंतालीस अलग अंतरिक्ष मॉड्यूल पृथ्वी के 15 चक्कर पूरे करेंगे। लेकिन क्यों?
vo.es: Antes de que termine tu día, cuarenta y tres módulos espaciales completarán quince vueltas a la Tierra. ¿Pero por qué?
vo.pt: Antes do seu dia acabar, quarenta e três módulos espaciais completarão quinze voltas ao redor da Terra. Mas por quê?

footage.q: wide establishing space station earth orbit
tracking shot iss glowing solar arrays
time lapse orbital sunset over oceans

vo.en: It travels at twenty-seven thousand six hundred kilometres per hour, roughly four hundred kilometres above Earth.
vo.hi: यह पृथ्वी से लगभग चार सौ किलोमीटर ऊपर, सत्ताईस हज़ार छह सौ किलोमीटर प्रति घंटे की रफ़्तार से चलता है।
vo.es: Viaja a veintisiete mil seisicentos kilómetros por hora, a unos cuatrocientos kilómetros sobre la Tierra.
vo.pt: Ela viaja a vinte e sete mil e seiscentos quilômetros por hora, a cerca de quatrocentos quilômetros acima da Terra.

footage.q: aerial perspective earth atmosphere curved horizon
extreme close up space station truss panel
fast motion time lapse earth city lights space

vo.en: At that speed, the station loops our planet every ninety-three minutes, completing fifteen point five orbits daily.
vo.hi: इस गति से, स्टेशन हर बानवे से तिरानवे मिनट में हमारी पृथ्वी का चक्कर पूरा करता है, रोज़ 15.5 चक्कर लगाकर।
vo.es: A esa velocidad, la estación rodea nuestro planeta cada noventa y tres minutos, completando quince punto cinco órbitas al día.
vo.pt: Nessa velocidade, a estação dá uma volta no nosso planeta a cada noventa e três minutos, completando quinze ponto cinco órbitas por dia.

footage.q: orbiting shot space station crossing dark ocean
macro detail robotic arm moving space station
low angle shot iss flying over clouds

vo.en: Inside this giant craft, forty-three modules host continuous human life in zero gravity.
vo.hi: इस विशाल यान के भीतर, तैंतालीस मॉड्यूल शून्य गुरुत्वाकर्षण में निरंतर मानव जीवन को बनाए रखते हैं।
vo.es: Dentro de esta nave gigante, cuarenta y tres módulos albergan vida humana continua en gravedad cero.
vo.pt: Dentro dessa nave gigante, quarenta e três módulos abrigam vida humana contínua em gravidade zero.

footage.q: interior wide shot pressurized space module floating
close up science experiment rack zero gravity
slow pan camera through space station corridor

vo.en: Floating in total vacuum, bacteria survived here for three full years without dying.
vo.hi: पूर्ण शून्य में तैरते हुए, बैक्टीरिया यहाँ बिना मरे पूरे तीन साल तक जीवित रहे।
vo.es: Flotando en el vacío total, las bacterias sobrevivieron aquí durante tres años completos sin morir.
vo.pt: Flutuando no vácuo total, bactérias sobreviveram aqui por três anos inteiros sem morrer.

footage.q: slow motion space vacuum exposure sample tray
extreme macro close up bacterial culture petri dish
cinematic slow pan earth atmospheric limb space

vo.en: And right above your city tonight, that massive orbit continues without stopping...
vo.hi: और आज रात आपके शहर के ठीक ऊपर, वह विशाल कक्षा बिना रुके जारी है...
vo.es: Y justo sobre tu ciudad esta noche, esa órbita masiva continúa sin detenerse...
vo.pt: E bem acima da sua cidade hoje à noite, essa órbita massiva continua sem parar...

footage.q: wide tracking space station passing night side earth
time lapse city lights from low earth orbit
cinematic tilt up iss structure back to earth horizon

vo.en: The station measures one hundred nine metres long, stretching solar wings across seventy-three metres.
vo.hi: यह स्टेशन एक सौ नौ मीटर लंबा है, जिसके सौर पंख सत्तर-तीन मीटर तक फैले हैं।
vo.es: La estación mide ciento nueve metros de largo, extendiendo alas solares a lo largo de setenta y tres metros.
vo.pt: A estação mede cento e nove metros de comprimento, estendendo asas solares ao longo de setenta e três metros.

footage.q: extreme wide angle space station full length view
tracking shot along gigantic iss solar arrays
close up solar panel texture reflection sunlight

vo.en: Since November second, two thousand, humans have lived aboard without a single day left empty.
vo.hi: 2 नवंबर 2000 से, इंसान बिना एक भी दिन खाली छोड़े यहाँ लगातार रह रहे हैं।
vo.es: Desde el dos de noviembre de dos mil, los humanos han vivido a bordo sin un solo día vacío.
vo.pt: Desde dois de novembro de dois mil, seres humanos vivem a bordo sem um único dia vazio.

footage.q: historical wide shot first station module launch
medium pan shot module docking orbital sequence
time lapse station construction assembling solar truss

vo.en: Two hundred ninety individuals from twenty-six nations have stepped into this zero-gravity lab.
vo.hi: छब्बीस देशों के दो सौ नब्बे लोग इस शून्य-गुरुत्वाकर्षण प्रयोगशाला में कदम रख चुके हैं।
vo.es: Doscientas noventa personas de veintiséis naciones han pisado este laboratorio de gravedad cero.
vo.pt: Duzentas e noventa pessoas de vinte e seis nações pisaram neste laboratório de gravidade zero.

footage.q: wide interior cupola view earth passing below
macro shot astronaut helmet visor earth reflection
tracking shot spacewalk astronaut working on truss

vo.en: Divided into Russian and American segments, international teams coordinate control of the station.
vo.hi: रूसी और अमेरिकी वर्गों में विभाजित, अंतर्राष्ट्रीय टीमें स्टेशन के नियंत्रण का समन्वय करती हैं।
vo.es: Dividida en segmentos ruso y estadounidense, equipos internacionales coordinan el control de la estación.
vo.pt: Dividida em segmentos russo e americano, equipes internacionais coordenam o controle da estação.

footage.q: wide establishing view exterior Russian orbital segment
close up shot US segment solar array junction
aerial drift camera along main station spine

vo.en: Orbiting between fifty-one point six four degrees north and south, it covers almost all human civilization.
vo.hi: 51.64 डिग्री उत्तर और दक्षिण के बीच चक्कर लगाते हुए, यह लगभग पूरी मानव सभ्यता को कवर करता है।
vo.es: Orbitando entre cincuenta y uno punto sesenta y cuatro grados norte y sur, cubre casi toda la civilización.
vo.pt: Orbitando entre cinquenta e um ponto sessenta e quatro graus norte e sul, cobre quase toda a civilização.

footage.q: time lapse view high inclination orbit earth horizon
tracking wide shot glowing aurora borealis space station
macro close up storm cloud tops lightning space

vo.en: With an internal space matching a Boeing seven forty seven, astronauts live inside one thousand five cubic metres.
vo.hi: बोइंग 747 के बराबर आंतरिक जगह के साथ, अंतरिक्ष यात्री 1,005 घन मीटर क्षेत्र में रहते हैं।
vo.es: Con un espacio interno comparable a un Boeing 747, los astronautas viven en mil cinco metros cúbicos.
vo.pt: Com um espaço interno comparável a um Boeing 747, os astronautas vivem em mil e cinco metros cúbicos.

footage.q: wide pan shot interior habitable research module
detail shot zero gravity equipment rack straps
slow motion floating water droplet microgravity lab

vo.en: Crews dedicate one hundred sixty man-hours weekly to research, testing how bodies survive space before Mars missions.
vo.hi: मंगल अभियानों से पहले शरीर के अस्तित्व का परीक्षण करते हुए, दल साप्ताहिक रूप से 160 घंटे शोध में बिताते हैं।
vo.es: Las tripulaciones dedican ciento sesenta horas hombre semanales a investigar la supervivencia humana antes de ir a Marte.
vo.pt: As tripulações dedicam cento e sessenta horas-homem semanais a pesquisas sobre a sobrevivência humana antes de Marte.

footage.q: close up ultrasound scanning procedure zero gravity
medium shot plant growth microgravity experiment rack
tracking shot alpha magnetic spectrometer exterior iss

vo.en: Until twenty thirty, this flying laboratory will remain humanity's main bridge to deep space.
vo.hi: 2030 तक, यह उड़ती प्रयोगशाला गहरे अंतरिक्ष के लिए मानवता का मुख्य पुल बनी रहेगी।
vo.es: Hasta dos mil treinta, este laboratorio volante seguirá siendo el puente principal hacia el espacio profundo.
vo.pt: Até dois mil e trinta, este laboratório voador continuará sendo a principal ponte para o espaço profundo.

footage.q: slow motion wide view space station orbit earth edge
cinematic pull back camera iss against deep starfield
extreme wide shot space station vanishing into sun flare

sources.title: Wikipedia, International Space Station
claims: at about 400 kilometres (250 miles) above Earth
Its orbit takes it at 7.67 km/s (27,600 km/h; 17,200 mph) roughly every 93 minutes around Earth, 15.5 times a day.
Measuring 109 m (358 ft) (with solar arrays) by 73 m (239 ft)
has a pressurised internal volume of 1,005 m3 (35,491 ft3), comparable to a Boeing 747 airliner.
In total, the station consists of 43 different modules and elements.
Deinococcus radiodurans bacteria, which is highly resistant to environmental hazards, were found to survive for three years in outer space
Since 2 November 2000, it has hosted the longest continuous human presence in space.
As of August 2025, 290 individuals from 26 countries had visited the station.
The station orbits between 51.64° north and south

ask.en: If you could spend 24 hours on the space station, what experiment would you run?
ask.hi: अगर आपको स्पेस स्टेशन पर 24 घंटे बिताने का मौका मिले, तो आप कौन सा प्रयोग करेंगे?
ask.es: Si pudieras pasar 24 horas en la estación espacial, ¿qué experimento harías?
ask.pt: Se você pudesse passar 24 horas na estação espacial, qual experimento faria?
